uploadDescription: Choose a PDF to watermark. Your files stay in your browser.
dropPdf: Drop a PDF here, or choose a file
imageDescription: PNG or JPEG, up to 20 MB. Transparent PNGs work best.
sizeDescription: Percentage of page width; scaled to fit when rotated.
pageRangeDescription: Leave blank for all pages, or enter ranges such as 1-3,5,8-10.
previewDescription: Check the watermark before downloading your PDF.
sampleLabel: Sample page · upload a PDF to preview your document
previewError: This page could not be previewed. Try another page.
readError: Could not read this PDF. Try a different file.
encryptedError: This PDF is encrypted. Unlock it before adding a watermark.
generateError: Could not generate the PDF. Try again or choose another file.
imageError: Could not read this image. Choose a PNG or JPEG up to 20 MB and 32 megapixels.
textError: Enter watermark text (up to 200 characters and 5 lines).
rangeInvalid: Use page numbers and ascending ranges separated by commas.
rangeBounds: One or more page numbers are outside this PDF.
rangeDuplicate: Remove repeated pages from the page range.
